root_cause: The existing LinkedIn sales machine previously marked a newly approved DM action done directly from a successful Composio SALESROBOT_SEND_MESSAGE response, without independent SalesRobot inbox proof or canonical outcome. It also checked action human approval but not the contact-level CRM authority.
prevention: No DM done/outcome from Composio ACK alone; hold original waiting with no-resend guard.
Use exact independently verified inbox message ID and prospect UUID in canonical runtime event before sent outcome is created.
Verify CRM contact authorization as well as action approval.
Leave blocked external license/session unresolved and do not misrepresent it as production-ready.
change: Add contact-level authorization and reconcile exact external inbox receipts to the existing action/outcome without introducing another sender or scheduler.
verification_required: licensed external provider and real authorized proof for full end-to-end
